_readme: Sanitized config used by the test suites. The suites copy this into a temp
dir next to a byte-copy of tinycmdr.py and import that, so they can run
against a fresh unpack where no config.json exists yet (CI, a new host, a
download). Every value here is fake on purpose: do not point it at a real
server, and never put a real token in it.
It is not the example to hand to a person: config.example.json is that, and it
spells out every key with fake values. This one exists so the suites have a
config that can never be mistaken for a real host's.
base_url is 127.0.0.1:1 (a port nothing listens on) and not a plausible port
like 8081: a fixture pointing at a live local service makes endpoint tests
reach something real and fail for the wrong reason.
